estimated_quantity: percentage points of photographed automatic white-hue ROI share per empirical original environmental standard deviation
source_inference_limits: Original photographic white/other four-hue ROIs are automatic visible flower-like object classifications and have not been independently botanically authenticated as open petals or tepals.
Globally positive annual water/photo-white association is conditional on sampled taxa/photographer/source geography and genus weighting, not a demonstrated causal water-pigment mechanism.
Under genus×coarse-geocell source conditioning, both rainfall and vapour simultaneous maxT intervals include zero.
Annual environment source uses historical WorldClim v2.1 1970–2000 normals, not original observed-year/month weather.
WorldClim raw srad is kJ per square metre per day despite historical misleading Watts label; the standardized source estimator is scale invariant but absolute raw units require dividing by 86.4.
No genotype colour-polymorphism, experimentally quantified pigment cost, selective fitness or reproductive success measured.
Global interspecific MOIS photo/moisture models do not reuse separate FCP intraspecific W/D and 50km estimators.
Some newer photographic source cohorts were admitted in actual computation terminal completion order, not unbiased sample recruitment.
MaxT adjusts the 24 hue x climate comparisons within each original model specification only, not the total history of exploratory source/model choices.
Photo hue classification, original photo IDs and 149653 actual date + hue observation count are unchanged by the statistical environmental refit.
